title: Exploring the Use of AI in Metadata Creation for the Social Science Japan Data Archive: Metadata Extraction from Social Surveys with an LLM Application

live_model.evidence: "最も高速なgpt-4.1-nanoでは24秒である...最も安価なgpt-4.1-nanoは0.06ドル" (the fastest, gpt-4.1-nano, takes 24 seconds; the cheapest, gpt-4.1-nano, costs $0.06, per metadata-creation run)

prompt.location: Sec. 2.2: prompt built with "OpenAI's prompt generator" then hand-adjusted for real operation; process illustrated in Fig. 2
prompt.note: Prompt-construction process is described, but the final prompt text is not quoted verbatim.

claim.metric: processing time per survey document's metadata-creation run
claim.location: Sec. 3.2, pilot study of 10 SSJDA survey documents; gpt-4.1-nano fastest at 24 seconds (cost $0.06)

data.source: Publicly available survey forms/reports from the SSJDA (Social Science Japan Data Archive) website; no individual-level microdata used

notes: The paper's accuracy comparison (cosine similarity to expert-made metadata, e.g. o3 0.974 vs ELYZA 0.755 on one field) is reported only for o3 vs. the local ELYZA model; gpt-4.1-nano and o3-mini (also tested, per Sec. 2.2) are given only speed/cost figures, not accuracy, in the excerpts read. o3-mini has no model-specific number at all in the extracted text.
